:::{#exm-bernoulli}
#### A coin flip

The [Bernoulli distribution](random-variables.qmd#def-bernoulli) describes a binary outcome.
The indicator of heads on one flip of a fair coin is $\Ber(1/2)$.
By the [expectation of the Bernoulli distribution](expectation.qmd#thm-bernoulli-mean),
$X \sim \Ber(\prob)$ has mean $\prob$,
and by the [variance of a Bernoulli random variable](variance-covariance.qmd#exm-variance-bernoulli),
it has variance $\prob(1 - \prob)$.

:::
